items.name: 38 degree wedge backboard base
items.selection_reason: One custom flat-bottom wedge backboard implementing the user-specified 38 degree top surface, upper-left R4 rounded-rectangle through opening, and parallel 4 mm slant-cut groove at 65 degrees to the surface.

risks.description: Overall wedge, opening, and groove dimensions are editable CAD defaults because the reference image has no scale.
